title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Add a set of first-class RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to redwood-examples and update the docs site to include quickstart walkthroughs and playground links. Motivation: provide opinionated starter templates for building retrieval-augmented generators and agents that call external tools (search, calendar, and SQL) so customers have production-ready examples that demonstrate best-practices for prompt design, chunking, vector store usage, and secure tool integration. This PR includes: 1) three agent templates (customer-support-rag, knowledge-bot-rag, and agent-with-tools) and matching README quickstarts; 2) tool adapter examples for Search, Calendar, and SQL with credential guidance and sandbox defaults; 3) docs site pages and sidebar entries with step-by-step quickstarts, a troubleshooting section, and playground links; 4) unit and integration tests for example harnesses and CI playbook updates. Checklist: - [x] Add example code and READMEs - [x] Add docs pages and sidebar metadata - [x] Add integration tests for example harness - [x] Run CI and address lint/test failures - [x] Add release notes entry. Testing and validation: local example harness, CI integration tests that spin up a lightweight vector-store fixture, and manual smoke test in the docs playground. Rollout: merged to main, docs site deploy to staging then production; no feature flags required. No breaking API changes. Related: ENG-4023 covers example maintenance and PM-78 tracked docs requests.

review_comments: Evan Blake: Small nit on README formatting and suggested clarifying the vector store TTL recommendation. Please add an explicit example of chunk size rationale.

Priya Kapoor (author): Added retry/backoff with exponential backoff and a short jitter for the fixture start. Re-ran tests locally and in CI.
Jordan Lee: Approved after tests were stable and docs styling fixed. Left a suggestion to add a small troubleshooting FAQ to the docs page.
Priya Kapoor (author): Added troubleshooting FAQ and a known-issues note about rate limits for public search adapters.

changes_summary: Introduces three opinionated RAG agent templates, tool adapter examples, docs site quickstarts and playground links, and CI integration tests to validate examples. Improves onboarding for engineers building retrieval-augmented agents and tool-calling integrations.
